check: whether the 23 never-run GameTests carry a stale baseline that the corridor change would have invalidated
why: The goal says the baseline is invalid because corridorHalfWidth moved from 192 to 512. If a never-run test also hardcoded the old value, its first execution would fail for a reason unrelated to the code - and that would look like a real defect. Checking separates the two.

result.fieldPositions: GenerationConfig declares algorithmVersion, templateVersion, segmentBlocks, stationBlocks, columnBudget, carrierAmplitude, corridorHalfWidth and so on, so the seventh argument is the corridor
result.verdict: The current value, not the old one.

theOtherFiveDoNotTouchIt: BiomeWriterGameTests, LifecycleGameTests, NegotiatedGateGameTests, PaletteGameTests and WallArchPreparationGameTests construct no GenerationConfig and reference none of columnBudget, corridorHalfWidth or carrierAmplitude. Their subjects are the biome painter, recipe lifecycle, gate negotiation, palette reload and arch preparation, none of which depends on that configuration.
whatThisRulesOut: That the 23 first-ever executions would fail on a stale constant rather than on their own subject matter. When they run, a failure will mean something about the code.
methodNote: An earlier pass appeared to find WorldRecipe constructions in two of these classes; the pattern was matching new WorldRecipeGuard, a different type. Checking the exact constructor names rather than a prefix is what separated them.
